title: ATOLine
description: The 'ATO line' phase of ENSIM's tasking sequence (ARCHITECTURE.md Section 3). Grounded in org-doctrine-model's hadr-request-and-tasking-flow doctrine process, step 5 ('ATO line', produced by the Air Mobility Division) and the ato-cycle doctrine process generally. Deliberately representative, not a real Air Tasking Order line format (USMTF/fixed-column ATO fields are not modeled — see AGENTS.md Section 3, the classification boundary).

taskedOrganizationId.description: org-doctrine-model Organization id of the unit tasked by this line, e.g. '535th-airlift-squadron'.
